section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Sexual Liberalism Scale (SLS) developed by Rye et al. (2015), a 29-item instrument measuring sexual liberalism or erotophilia. Items are rated on a 7-point scale from 'Strongly disagree' to 'Strongly agree,' and the scale demonstrates good construct validity and internal consistency. The authors note that while Rye et al. did not report factorial validity, they elected to examine the factor structure and internal consistency of the SLS in their Results section.
